meta.name: Eco Count Plastic Knowledge Base
meta.description: A broad practical first-pass knowledge base for classifying everyday items as confirmed plastic, assumable plastic, or clearly non-plastic before using Google verification.

classification_rule.confirmed_plastic: Known/common plastic item. Count as Plastic.
classification_rule.assumeable_plastic: Item can reasonably be manufactured from plastic. Count as Plastic/Likely plastic unless clearly described as another material.
classification_rule.cannot_be_plastic: Clearly non-plastic material/item. Do not count.
classification_rule.fallback: If no local match exists, V2 asks Google for: can <item> be plastic. Only a clear yes/no becomes Likely plastic/Not a plastic. Otherwise Can't determine.
